name: Paris Basin
tagline: Mild weather, millions of users next door.
context: Mild weather, a decent river and millions of users nearby. Wind, sun and water are all average: you will have to mix.
source: Relative wind, sun and river resources are game values, plausible in direction (Nordic winds and hydro, southern sun).

name: Nordic Fjord
tagline: Cold air, strong wind, a powerful river, far from users.
context: Strong winds and a powerful river make clean power easy; fuel must be shipped in. Far from users: clients pay less and arrive slower.
source: Relative wind, sun and river resources are game values, plausible in direction (Nordic winds and hydro, southern sun).

name: Coal Valley
context: Coal is mined next door, so fuel is cheap and tempting. Wind and sun are average, the river is modest.

name: Sun Belt
tagline: Endless sun, tax breaks, and not much water.
